BADGE_X.note: ellipse major axis; FastWRX 'about 5 in', user-confirmed

BADGE_Y.note: ellipse minor axis; FastWRX 'about 2 1/2 in', user-confirmed

BODY_T.note: flat back to the face AT THE EDGE, user-confirmed

CROWN_RISE.note: face rises this much from edge to centre, same all round (ellipsoidal), user-confirmed

RIM_W.note: radial width of the raised rim, user-confirmed

RIM_H.note: rim stands this far proud of the curved face, user-confirmed

GRAPHIC_W.note: traced letters scaled to this ink width; 85% of the badge, user-confirmed

GRAPHIC_H.note: letters stand this far proud of the curved face, user-confirmed

PIN_X.note: half of the trunk's 100 mm hole centre-to-centre, user-measured with a caliper

PIN_HOLE_D.note: press-fit hole for the 3.0 tang, user-confirmed

PIN_HOLE_DEPTH.note: blind, flat ceiling: a 2.9 mm bridge when printed face-up, user-confirmed

POINT_ANGLE_DEG.note: pin point surface from vertical. DEGREES, not mm

PIN_SHAFT_D.note: 0.2 under the trunk's 7.5 mm hole, user-measured; slips in

PIN_SHAFT_L.note: 16 ga sheet (1.5, unconfirmed) + 1 mm foam + 2.5 spare, user-confirmed

PIN_TANG_L.note: matches PIN_HOLE_DEPTH so the shoulder seats on the back, user-confirmed

PIN_POINT_D.note: base of the point, 0.3 in from the tang so the Z-scan sees where the tang ends
